title: Cook  -  A Hot Meal Before the Next Shift
design_overview:
Cook  -  A Hot Meal Before the Next Shift

**Premise and dialogue:** “Nobody works well on an empty stomach. Show me the kitchen and where the meals belong. We'll cook this little batch for free.”

**Existing:** food-producing crafting, smelting and smoking, with actual station timers and output selection. Cook already does more than meat cooking. Choose two portions from a verified smoking recipe, such as default raw cod to cooked cod if available. The chef extra-food perk applies to automatic work and continuous orders after the lesson; this free trial has no bonus and remains exactly two portions.

steps.title: 1 Take the first shift
steps.design_check: COOK lesson reserved and worker bound.
steps.design_provisions: free two-meal assignment and shared Clipboard if needed.
steps.design_notes:
1 Take the first shift

**Tutor:** “I'll cook two portions for our first shift. This little batch is on me.”

**Check:** COOK lesson reserved and worker bound.

**Provides:** free two-meal assignment and shared Clipboard if needed.

steps.title: 2 Mark a usable kitchen

cards.text: Open {Inventory}. Right-click the Clipboard slot until it reads Edit Job Site, then close the inventory. With it in your hand, point at our smoker and press {Use}.

See the box? Scroll to move it, or hold {ControlModifier} while scrolling to make it wider or narrower. Hold {ShiftModifier} and scroll to change its height position; {ControlModifier} and {AltModifier} together change its height. Include the work and a clear way to reach it.
When the box fits, point at me, your Cook, and press {Use} without sneaking. Show me the area you chose.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Preview our smoker, then acknowledge the actual saved area on the bound Cook. Do not complete for moving or merely displaying the box.
sequences.recovery: That is only the draft until you apply it to me. If it is in the wrong place, point at the right centre and use the Clipboard again. To start fresh, hold {Sneak} and press {Attack} on a block in Edit Job Site, then redraw. Keep protected or unrelated work outside.

steps.design_objective: Apply an area containing a reachable smoker.
steps.design_check: actual worker area and station interaction/path validation.
steps.design_provisions: smoker loan or demonstration station and a note that supported crafted foods instead need their crafting setup.
steps.design_notes:
2 Mark a usable kitchen

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Open {Inventory}. Right-click the Clipboard slot until it reads Edit Job Site, then close the inventory. With it in your hand, point at our smoker and press {Use}.”
2. “See the box? Scroll to move it, or hold Control while scrolling to make it wider or narrower. Hold Shift and scroll to change its height position; Control and Alt together change its height. Include the work and a clear way to reach it.”
3. “When the box fits, point at me, your Cook, and press {Use} without sneaking. Show me the area you chose.”

**Show / confirm:** Preview our smoker, then acknowledge the actual saved area on the bound Cook. Do not complete for moving or merely displaying the box.

**If it goes wrong:** “That is only the draft until you apply it to me. If it is in the wrong place, point at the right centre and use the Clipboard again. To start fresh, hold {Sneak} and press {Attack} on a block in Edit Job Site, then redraw. Keep protected or unrelated work outside.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Show me the smoker, and make sure I can get to it.”

**Task:** Apply an area containing a reachable smoker.

**Check:** actual worker area and station interaction/path validation.

**Provides:** smoker loan or demonstration station and a note that supported crafted foods instead need their crafting setup.

steps.title: 3 Set pantry and serving chest

cards.text: Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold {ControlModifier} and scroll until it says Assign Supplies.
Point at the supplies chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.
Now point at me, your Cook, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Identify this lesson’s supplies chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Supplies link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.
sequences.recovery: If you selected the wrong chest, close the menu, aim into empty air, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} with the Clipboard to clear the selection. Select the right chest and choose Assign Clipboard Storage again. If you cannot open the chest to load it, put the Clipboard away first.

cards.text: Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold {ControlModifier} and scroll until it says Assign Output Storage.
Point at the output chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.
Now point at me, your Cook, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Identify this lesson’s output chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Output link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.

steps.design_check: real records, access, filters and two-meal capacity.
steps.design_provisions: provenance-tracked container loans where needed and source/destination preview.

steps.title: 4 Choose the meal

cards.text: Hold the lesson’s Recipe Filter in your main hand. Aim into empty air and press {Use} without sneaking to open it. Click the < or > arrows until the recipe for the approved two-portion cooked food recipe is shown.
Leave the mode button on Allow (Allow Matching). Check the displayed ingredient and result against the lesson card, then close the filter. Do not sneak-use it: that clears it.

Put the filter away, use an empty hand on me, and choose Job → Job Inventory. Pick up the configured Recipe Filter with a left mouse click, then left-click my filter slot to place it. Show me the installed filter.
Put the Clipboard away before opening the supply chest. Press {Use} on the chest with an empty hand and place the allocated ingredients and fuel, where required, in it.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Highlight the actual filter slot and selected recipe ID/result. Confirm the installed filter and effective runtime recipe, not just an open filter editor. Supply a Recipe Filter as a once-only lesson loan if needed. The tutorial needs a slot highlight; do not invent a slot number or a keyboard shortcut.
sequences.recovery: If the recipe is absent, stop and show the missing supported recipe; do not pretend a similar result is the same recipe. If a different filter is already installed, retain it safely and ask before replacing it. Use the arrows again to correct a wrong selection.

steps.design_objective: Configure the existing output filter for the selected cooked result.
steps.design_check: effective food selection accepts the runtime-resolved recipe and station contents are compatible.
steps.design_provisions: exactly two raw inputs plus sufficient valid fuel once, with ingredient and station guidance. Tutorial authority supplies the finite cap; do not imply a settlement production panel is required.

steps.title: 5 Cook the batch

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.
Choose Ask for Work Report first. If work is paused, click Start/Pause Work once. Leave it alone if work is already enabled, then close the conversation so I can work.
Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Confirm work-enabled authority for this finite trial and show the real next worker action. Starting work is not evidence that the harvest, craft or delivery succeeded.
sequences.recovery: If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.

steps.design_check: allocated ingredients loaded, actually processed and collected by the assigned worker.
steps.design_provisions: truthful waiting and missing-fuel/path/full-output diagnostics. Aptitude does not remove vanilla processing time.
steps.design_notes:
5 Cook the batch

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.”
2. “Choose Ask for Work Report first. If work is paused, click Start/Pause Work once. Leave it alone if work is already enabled, then close the conversation so I can work.”
3. “Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.”

**Show / confirm:** Confirm work-enabled authority for this finite trial and show the real next worker action. Starting work is not evidence that the harvest, craft or delivery succeeded.

**If it goes wrong:** “If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Let the smoker do its work. I'll collect the meals when they're ready.”

**Task:** Enable work.

**Check:** allocated ingredients loaded, actually processed and collected by the assigned worker.

**Provides:** truthful waiting and missing-fuel/path/full-output diagnostics. Aptitude does not remove vanilla processing time.

steps.title: 6 Serve and close the shift

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the output chest to open it and look at what arrived.
Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Cook, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.
sequences.recovery: If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.

steps.design_objective: Inspect Output and speak to the cook.
steps.design_check: both attributable meals deposited; stop new free work.
steps.design_notes:
6 Serve and close the shift

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the output chest to open it and look at what arrived.”
2. “Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Cook, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.”

**Show / confirm:** Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.

**If it goes wrong:** “If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Two meals ready. Shall we talk about another shift?”

**Task:** Inspect Output and speak to the cook.

**Check:** both attributable meals deposited; stop new free work.

**Provides/reward:** those meals and a brief introduction to supported food crafting. “There's your first hot batch. Want another shift? Let's look at my normal rate.” Apply shared ending.

**A Continue working:** “Show me your normal price.” Present the current role, duration, currency and total. Start ordinary paid work only after the player accepts a still-valid quote.

**B Stop here:** “Thanks. Stop working.” End this tutorial assignment safely, reconcile its output and identifiable loans, and keep the lesson completed. Dismissal leaves work paused.


**New hooks:** station and effective recipe/filter validation; input allocations; worker-attributed processed collection and destination deposit. Mere inventory totals or a cooking status cannot complete the lesson.
